entities.name: Koskun
entities.description: Mountainous region in Ulgrotha with a keep, a river and waterfalls.

entities.name: An-Zerrin
entities.description: Small ruined castle in the Koskun Mountains.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ruler whose servants killed An-Zerrin's occupants and raised them in death.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Defeated Sandruu on Kher Ridge and was killed by Feroz.

entities.name: Monument to Feroz
entities.description: Monument created on Kher Ridge by Serra.

entities.name: Koskun Keep
entities.description: Stronghold of goblins and thieves ruled by Eron the Relentless.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Neighbor that buys protection from Eron.

entities.name: Strongrock
entities.description: Fortress at the base of Koskun Keep.

entities.name: Koskun Falls
entities.description: Waterfalls marking the border between Koskun Keep and the Dark Barony.

events.summary: Baron Sengir kills An-Zerrin's occupants and they serve him in death.
events.quote: Its occupants were killed by Baron Sengir and served him in death.

events.summary: Taysir of Rabiah defeats Sandruu on Kher Ridge, and Feroz later kills Taysir.
events.quote: This was where Taysir of Rabiah defeated Sandruu , and where Feroz killed Taysir.

relations.quote: It is ruled by Eron the Relentless
The Monument to Feroz was created here by Serra .
